Duleep Trophy Semifinals: Key Performances and Records Set

The Duleep Trophy semifinals are underway with notable performances from several players. In one match, Central Zone was bowled out for 266, with Mukesh Kumar and Abhijit Sarkar taking wickets. In another semifinal, South Zone's Vidwath Kaverappa took four wickets, putting his team in control. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi achieved a record by becoming the youngest captain and the youngest half-centurion in the Duleep Trophy's history. East Zone reached 81/0 in their semi-final.
